description: 4G premises: signal from 2 operators - WMCA is a dataset listed in Birmingham City Observatory open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ofcom. This metric shows the proportion of residential and small business premises with a reliable 4G signal from two of the four mobile network operators (EE, Vodafone, O2 or Three). ie, for this proportion of the area only one network is available. For overall coverage see all operators metric. Coverage: West Midlands Combined Authority area, including Birmingham. The portal files it under Connected City. Its keywords are west midlands combined authority, wmca, internet, mobile phone. The portal shows 117 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OGL-UK-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-cityobservatory-birmingham-gov-uk-portal.
